control_plane_write_deny.implementation: agent edit denies + experimental hard policies

arbitrary_shell_deny.implementation: shell:* deny in write/read-only agents; narrow exceptions

scope_prewrite.notes: vanilla OpenCode permissions are static per session/task

scope_prepass.implementation: deterministic scope check blocks PASS and emits SCOPE_ESCALATION

compaction.implementation: OpenCode V2 auto compaction keep=8000 buffer=20000

structured_handoff.notes: Transport is inline in OpenCode v1.5; persistent handoff artifact transport is a later phase.

context_budget.implementation: portable ContextOS budget engine + OpenCode/Qwen runtime profile
context_budget.notes: Automatic exact-token telemetry feed is a later ContextOS phase.

checkpoint_resume.implementation: portable ContextOS checkpoint/resume engine with SHA-256 sealed state under .aledevos/state/contextos
checkpoint_resume.notes: Exact automatic token telemetry feed is deferred to ContextOS telemetry phase; OpenCode native compaction remains a safety net.

preventive_transition.implementation: ContextOS pressure bands require verified checkpoint + resume before COMPACT_REQUIRED/HARD_GUARD transitions
preventive_transition.notes: Adapter-specific automatic invocation is completed when telemetry wiring is added.

diff_first.implementation: portable ContextOS bounded git diff snapshot + untracked-file hash/preview without staging
diff_first.notes: Review agents are instructed to escalate from diff to targeted excerpt/full file only when necessary.

context_dedup.implementation: portable SHA-256 context-item ledger + budgeted context packet planner
context_dedup.notes: De-duplicates task payloads; runtime/provider system prompts may still be resent by the runtime.

skill_registry.implementation: portable Skill System metadata registry + OpenCode logical-ID bindings with SHA-256 drift detection
skill_registry.notes: Skill System 1.1 includes routing, composition, on-demand loading, governance, telemetry and Safe Acquisition; runtime-specific execution remains adapter-owned.

motion_governance.implementation: UX/UI Phase 5 Motion Director + canonical Motion Language + sealed Motion Contracts/Reviews
motion_governance.notes: Specialist motion Skills route on demand through Skill System and Safe Acquisition; rendered visual quality remains Visual QA.

visual_qa_capture_contract.implementation: Visual QA Phase 1 deterministic capture matrix + sealed PNG/source evidence verification
visual_qa_capture_contract.notes: Browser execution is intentionally deferred to Phase 2; Phase 1 makes no visual-quality or regression claim.

visual_qa_browser_capture.implementation: Visual QA Phase 2 adapter-owned deterministic Chromium/Playwright capture runner + sealed execution receipt
visual_qa_browser_capture.notes: Requires an available Playwright/Chromium runtime. Phase 2 attests browser execution and screenshot provenance only; Phase 3 consumes the receipt for regression.

visual_qa_regression.implementation: Visual QA Phase 3 immutable approved baseline store + portable deterministic PNG pixel regression + hashed diff/report verification
visual_qa_regression.notes: Only named baseline-pinned tolerance profiles are allowed. Baseline promotion requires explicit approval and is never automatic after FAIL.

visual_qa_runtime_checks.implementation: Visual QA Phase 4 sealed rendered DOM/layout/accessibility audit through adapter-owned Chromium/Playwright provider
visual_qa_runtime_checks.notes: Requires ACTIVE canonical accessibility/responsive policies. Current deterministic scope covers overflow, focusable clipping/containment, keyboard focus, accessible names, image alt, WCAG 2.2 AA target size and measurable rendered text contrast; it does not claim full WCAG or aesthetics.

visual_qa_judge.implementation: Visual QA Phase 5 sealed native-image semantic judge with Core-recomputed rubric scores and fail-closed UNVERIFIED handling
visual_qa_judge.notes: Requires a target runtime/model capable of native image observation. If image evidence cannot be observed, Phase 5 must BLOCK rather than infer visual quality.

visual_qa_bounded_repair.implementation: Visual QA Phase 5 sealed repair authorization/cycle controller integrated with the global max_repairs=2 run state
visual_qa_bounded_repair.notes: Repairs are restricted to approved product scope, may not promote baselines or edit canonical policies, and require fresh revisioned P2→P5 evidence before acceptance.

target_runtime_preflight.implementation: V1 release runtime derives target readiness from real adapter/browser availability, native-image model declaration and security policy
target_runtime_preflight.notes: Preflight is fail-closed. AleDevOS does not bundle a provider or model; native-image Visual Judge readiness remains BLOCKED until compatible target-runtime evidence is configured and verified.

v1_release_validation.implementation: sealed eight-check V1 release gate over real target evidence, deterministic regression, security and bounded-repair outcomes
v1_release_validation.notes: V1 may be frozen only after V1_RELEASE_READY. Controlled test providers cannot satisfy target browser evidence, missing/BLOCKED evidence cannot be waived, and all evidence/report artifacts are SHA-256 sealed.
